test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements about a commercial motor:

(a) It uses an electromagnet in place of a permanent magnet.

(b) It uses a soft-iron core.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is** '__Both (a) and (b)__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• A **commercial electric motor** is one which uses the following:

 
 
• An **electromagnet in place of a permanent magnet**.
 
• **A large number of turns of the conducting wire** in the current carrying coil.
 
• A **soft iron core on which the coil** is wound. The combination of a soft iron core and coil is called an **armature**. It enhances the power of the motor.
 
• Thus, commercial electric motors **do not use a permanent magnet **to rotate the armature because permanent magnets are weak and do not produce a strong magnetic field in the region.
